Answer: E
Reason: The initial images show a right hilar mass with pleural effusion, while the follow-up images demonstrate significant reduction in the mass size after treatment, leaving behind residual atelectatic tracts and traction bronchiectasis; this response to antibiotics combined with fibrotic sequelae is characteristic of pulmonary nocardiosis.
